'''Lusara''' was a merchant from [[Arad Doman]]. 

== Appearance and personality ==
She is buxom and copper-skinned. She is well into her middle years and has a few white hairs amongst her black hair, which falls below her shoulders. She is stunningly beautiful.{{ref/book|c|Lusara}}  

She has a flippant attitude towards risks others take seriously. She treated [[Faile Bashere|Faile's]] escape plans "like a child's game" and gained and lost several fortunes as a merchant.{{ref/book|11|5}}

== Activities ==
She was made ''[[gai'shain]]'' by the [[Shaido]] and was one of [[Sevanna]]'s personal servants.{{ref/book|11|5}}

She pledged an oath of fealty to [[Faile Bashere]] in the hopes of being taken with Faile when she eventually escaped from the Shaido.{{ref/book|11|5}}

She was present when Faile's supporters gathered to see her go.{{ref/book|11|28}} She was never mentioned again, so may have been unable to escape the Shaido camp.
